interpretation.reference_and_pin_identity: Each (ref,pin) is a unique external terminal; pin is a string, never a decimal number.
interpretation.net_identity: Only net_id defines external electrical connectivity. Original and continuous net names and CAD classes are aliases/appearance metadata.
interpretation.unrecorded: A null net_id means external wiring is not recorded; never merge null endpoints, and never infer real hardware disuse or internal isolation.
interpretation.internals: Do not expand unknown board/driver/relay internals, add missing supply paths, or permanently join relay COM to NO.
interpretation.colors: Logical diagram colors, not verified physical insulation colors. Same color is not the same net.
interpretation.coordinates: Optional schematic drawing positions only; not mounting dimensions or cable lengths.
